library(tradeSeq)
assocRes <- associationTest(sce, lineages = TRUE, l2fc = log2(2))
wtGenes <-  rownames(assocRes)[
  which(p.adjust(assocRes$pvalue_lineage1_conditionwt, "fdr") <= 0.05)
]
koGenes <-  rownames(assocRes)[
  which(p.adjust(assocRes$pvalue_lineage1_conditionko, "fdr") <= 0.05)
]

length(wtGenes)

venn3 <- rownames(condRes)[condRes$pvalue_lineage3 <= 1e-2]
venn2 <- rownames(condRes)[condRes$pvalue_lineage2 <= 1e-2]
venn1 <- rownames(condRes)[condRes$pvalue_lineage1 <= 1e-2]
vennall <- union(union(venn1, venn2), union(venn3, venn4))
write.csv2(vennall, file ='~/scRNAseq/analysis/DEGs/DEG-CCRegSub/setGAM4venn.csv', row.names=FALSE, quote = FALSE)

boxplot(slingPseudotime(sds)[,2] ~ conditions2, col = brewer.pal(3,'Set1')[1:2], main = 'Lineage 2', xlab='Condition', ylab='Pseudotime', las=1, pch = 16)

ptAs <- c() #assigned pseudotime
for(ii in 1:nrow(pt)) ptAs[ii] <- pt[ii,assignment[ii]] 
cond1 <- factor(conditions2[assignment == 1])
t1 <- ptAs[assignment == 1]
m1 <- glm(cond1 ~ t1, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"))
summary(m1)
plot(m1)

cond2 <- factor(conditions2[assignment == 4])
t2 <- ptAs[assignment == 4]
m2 <- glm(cond2 ~ t2, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"))
summary(m2)

m1s <- mgcv::gam(cond1 ~ s(t1), family="quasibinomial")
summary(m1s)
plot(m1s)

m2s <- mgcv::gam(cond2 ~ s(t2), family="quasibinomial")
summary(m2s)
plot(m2s)

colnames(mdata2)<- c('t1','fit1','se1','t2','fit2','se2')

mdata2$max1 <- mdata2$fit1+mdata2$se1
mdata2$min2 <- mdata2$fit2-mdata2$se2
mdata2$max2 <- mdata2$fit2+mdata2$se2
ggplot(mdata2,aes(x=t1,y=fit1))+geom_line(aes(x=t1,y=fit1))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min1, ymax = max1), fill='grey', alpha=0.3)+
  geom_line(aes(x=t2,y=fit2))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min2, ymax = max2), fill='red', alpha=0.3)

Code for !!!R console !!!

library(Seurat)
library(future)
library(dplyr)
dc <- readRDS('dcSubReg-for-future.2020.06.07.rds')
# Enable parallelization
plan("multiprocess", workers = 16)
degls <- vector("list", length = 10)
for (i in 0:9) {
    degls[[i+1]] <- FindMarkers(dc, ident.1 = "wt", ident.2 = "ko", group.by = 'genotype', subset.ident = i, min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.10)
}
saveRDS(degls, 'degls-2020-06-07.rds')
setDEG = vector()
for (i in 1:10) {
  lessthen10 <- degls[[i]][degls[[i]]$p_val_adj<=1e-13,]
  print(nrow(lessthen10))
  setDEG <- union(setDEG, rownames(lessthen10))
}
DoHeatmap(subset(dcSubReg, idents = 'ko'), features = setDEG, size = 3)
dcDEG <- subset(x = dcSubReg, features = setDEG)
dc255 <- readRDS("~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/dc255.rds")
ave <- AverageExpression(dc255, add.ident = 'cluster', return.seurat = TRUE)
ave2 <- ave[[1]]
ave2 <- ave2[ , order(names(ave2))]

library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
#remotes::install_github("tleonardi/ggheatmap")
library(ggheatmap)
plots <- ggheatmap(ave2%>%mutate_if(is.numeric,scale), orderCol = F, colorPalette = "PiYG")

library(Seurat)
dc <- readRDS('dcSubReg-for-future.2020.06.07.rds')
degls <- readRDS('~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/degls-2020-06-07.rds')
setDEG = vector()
for (i in 1:10) {
  lessthen10 <- degls[[i]][degls[[i]]$p_val_adj<=1e-13,]
  print(nrow(lessthen10))
  setDEG <- union(setDEG, rownames(lessthen10))
}
setDEG
new.cluster.ids <- c("pDC", "HSPC1", "cDC", "monocytes", "Progenitor", "HSPC2 (Neutro)", "Neutrophil", "HSPC3 (T Blast)",  "cd8DC","Mast cell")
Idents(dcSubReg) <- "seurat_clusters"
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(dcSubReg)
dcSubReg <- RenameIdents(dcSubReg, new.cluster.ids)
dc72 <- dcSubReg[['RNA']]@data[setDEG,]
dc72 <- CreateSeuratObject(dc72)
genotype <- dcSubReg@meta.data[, 'genotype']
dc72 <- AddMetaData(object = dc72, metadata = genotype, col.name = 'genotype')
Idents(dc72) <- 'genotype'
cluster <- dcSubReg@meta.data[, 'rnaClusterID']
cluster
dc72 <- AddMetaData(object = dc72, metadata = cluster, col.name = 'cluster')
clusterID <- dcSubReg@active.ident
dc72 <- AddMetaData(object = dc72, metadata = clusterID, col.name = 'clusterID')
dc72wt <- subset(dc72, idents = 'wt')
dc72ko <- subset(dc72, idents = 'ko')
ave72 <- AverageExpression(dc72, add.ident = 'clusterID')
ave72 <- ave72[[1]]
write.csv(ave72, "analysis/data/ave72.csv")
ave722 <- as.data.frame(scale(t(ave72)))
row.names(ave722) <- row.names(as.data.frame(t(ave72)))
ggheatmap(ave722, orderRow = F, colorPalette = "RdYlBu")
ave723 <- ave722[-c(6,8,19,20),] # no neutro
ave723 <- ave722[c(3,4,5,7,12,17),] # pDC
ave723 <- ave722[-c(4,5,12,17, 6,8,19,20),] # mono
ave723[is.na(ave723)] <- 0
scale_fill_distiller(palette ="RdBu", direction = -1)
ggheatmap(ave723*-1, orderRow = F, colorPalette = "RdYlBu")
degAll <- FindMarkers(dcSubReg, ident.1 = "wt", ident.2 = "ko", min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.10)
degAll45 <- rownames(degAll[degAll$p_val_adj<1e-45,])
setdiff(degAll45, setDEG)
# Not a good strategy, too much cluster shifting
setDEGwt = vector()
for (i in 1:10) {
  lessthen10 <- degls[[i]][degls[[i]]$p_val_adj<=1e-13 & degls[[i]]$avg_logFC>0,]
  print(nrow(lessthen10))
  setDEGwt <- union(setDEGwt, rownames(lessthen10))
}
setDEGwt
setDEGko = vector()
for (i in 1:10) {
  lessthen10 <- degls[[i]][degls[[i]]$p_val_adj<=1e-13 & degls[[i]]$avg_logFC<0,]
  print(nrow(lessthen10))
  setDEGko <- union(setDEGko, rownames(lessthen10))
}
setDEGko

for (i in c(1,2,8)) {
